verdict.rationale: Avalara documents an official MCP server exposing tax calculation, transaction retrieval/creation, and nexus definition lookups (avalara-docs-6,7,8,13,17,18, probe-3), which lets an agent read nexus status and transaction data and act via structured tools. However, there is no evidence covering registrations, accrued liability summaries, or upcoming filing schedules as MCP/API objects, nor any mention of scoped/limited credentials for the MCP surface (only general API access via SDKs). Missing for 10: registration status endpoints, accrued liability/filing calendar data, and scoped-credential/permission model for the MCP or API surface.
